g.text: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 06 · NORMAL CONDUCTION AT BOTH STATIONS
Rectifier: T3 + T6 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current | Inverter: T1 + T6 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.
